name: dessn
description: You can now use Dessn from your favourite agent. More convenient, more context. And all the visual power of Dessn.

interface.longDescription:
Dessn is the visual layer for designing and building with your agent. It renders your real app from its own code, with mocked data, so every page and its states (empty, error, a step of a flow) can sit side by side on a canvas your team clicks through and comments on. Your agent shows you the product instead of describing it.

• See what's live: put every page of your app on one board, grouped by area, and click through any of them.
• See every state: show a page in its empty, error and edge states, from your app's own routes and mock data.
• See what's drifting: audit screens against your app's own components and tokens, with a note pinned where each one drifts.
• Map entire journeys: lay out a user flow as a board of real screens, labelled arrows and notes your team can comment on.
• Explore without risk: each variation is a copy of a frame, its own running app, side by side with the original.
• Bring it home: take a design back to your repository as a git patch.

Reading your canvas and changing boards use no credits; asking Dessn's design agent to design something does. You need a Dessn account (create.dessn.ai); a new account can start from a starter app. From a web chat your agent reads code and lays out boards, and asks Dessn's design agent for code changes; an agent on your own computer can also edit a frame's code and capture a live site.
defaultPrompt: Map this app's user journey on my Dessn page "Screen flow": the screens first, then arrows between them, then notes.
Put every screen of my Dessn project on one page, grouped by area.
On my Dessn page "Layout ideas", explore three new layouts for this app's main screen with its own components.
